name: Album Gallery – Create Flickr Album Gallery on WordPress
author: FARAZFRANK

sections.description:
Flickr Album Gallery lets you showcase your Flickr albums on your WordPress site effortlessly. Perfect for photographers, bloggers, and businesses, this plugin offers a user-friendly way to display stunning photo galleries with lightbox previews and SEO optimization.

Why Choose Flickr Album Gallery?

Two-Column Layouts: Clean, professional display for your photos.
Lightbox Previews: Full-size image viewing with smooth transitions.
SEO-Friendly: Title tags and alt text boost search engine rankings.
Easy Setup: Create galleries using your Flickr API Key and Album ID.
Photo Limit: Up to 200 photos per album in the free version.

Upgrade to the Pro Version for advanced features like multiple column layouts, responsive Bootstrap design, 8 hover effects, lazy loading, masonry layouts, and support for up to 500 photos per album.

Free Version Features:

  • Gallery Title
  • Two Column Layout
  • SEO Friendly Album Galleries
  • Album Images Lightbox Preview
  • One Lightbox
  • Photo Limit 200 Per Album

Pro Version Features:

  • Multiple Columns
  • Multiple Lightbox Options
  • Responsive Bootstrap Based Gallery Layout
  • SEO Friendly Album
  • Thumbnail Image Size Setting
  • Lightbox Image Size Setting
  • Thumbnail Limit Setting
  • Default User Settings
  • Image Hover Color
  • Image Hover Color Opacity
  • Photo Limit 500 Per Album
  • 8 Mouse Hover Effect And Animations On Album Thumbnails
  • Lazy Loading Setting
  • Masonry Layout
  • Custom CSS

sections.installation:
1. Go to your WordPress dashboard and navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for “Flickr Album Gallery” and click Install Now.
  3. Activate the plugin after installation.
  4. Navigate to Flickr Album Gallery > Add New Gallery in your dashboard.
  5. Enter your gallery title, Flickr API Key, and Album ID.
  6. Optionally, add custom CSS for styling.
  7. Publish the gallery and use the shortcode [FAG id=123] in posts, pages, or widgets.
sections.faq:
Q: How do I get my Flickr API Key?

  • A: Visit Flickr API Guide for step-by-step instructions.

Q: How do I get my Flickr Album ID?

  • A: Follow the guide at Flickr Album ID Guide.

Q: Is this plugin compatible with the latest WordPress version?

  • A: Yes, we always keep tested plugin with latest release.

Q: Can I use this plugin with page builders like Elementor or Gutenberg?

  • A: Yes, the shortcode [FAG id=123] works with all major page builders.

Q: How do I update my gallery after adding new photos to Flickr?

  • A: Edit the gallery in the plugin dashboard and republish it.

Q: Is there any Photo limit in free plugin?

  • A: Yes, you can show up to 200 images per album in free plugin and Pro version is allowed 500 images in each album.

Q: How do I get support?

  • A: Visit the WordPress Support Forum or contact us at WP Frank Website.
